value.reviewerBoundary: Evaluate the returned result and reconstruct its evidence graph; do not repeat the producing role's work.
value.defaultVerification: Identity, predecessor chain, authority resolution, claim-obligation-evidence coverage, contradictions and manifest checks.
value.rerunRule: Focused only when disposition-relevant; broad rerun requires named insufficiency or contradiction, bounded claim, expected information gain and cost/latency justification.
value.missingEvidenceRule: Return or block missing work; reviewer must not silently complete it.
value.nextAllowedMove: Author and review the GCLH-T2 protected-path work order; implementation remains unopened.
value.claimBoundary: Review-cost design amendment only; no implementation or downstream/external effect.
